tasks.title: Add DeepSeek spend (local DSH sessions)
tasks.description: New cost tool 'deepseek' in bin/ai-usage: fold ~/.dsh/sessions/*/session.v*.jsonl(.zstd) assistant/message usage, price deepseek-flash / deepseek-v4-pro at official peak/off-peak rates, expose today/week/month, 14-day history, top models and sessions, last-hour rate; detect when ~/.dsh/sessions exists. Swift: palette, fallback symbol and app icon for the tool. Docs + tests. Done when python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v and ./build.sh pass and the collector emits real non-zero DeepSeek cost from this Mac's session logs.

history.evidence: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests (24 tests OK); python3 tests/check_swift.py OK; ./install.sh reports DeepSeek today $1.05 ok; snapshot /tmp/ai-usage-deepseek.png shows the row.
